_doc: Guided steps per recipe, in pot order. Each step: [instruction, [ingredient keys added in this step], timer seconds (0 = none), 'wait until' cue]. Quantities come from recipes.json. DRAFT: needs checking by a home cook.

ayam-masak-merah: Rub the chicken with half the salt
Heat the oil and fry the chicken in batches
Golden on both sides, about 10 min. Lift out and set aside
Blend the soaked dried chili with the shallots, garlic and ginger
Pour off all but 3 tbsp oil. Fry the cinnamon and star anise
Add the chili paste. Tumis on low-medium heat, stirring often
Pecah minyak: the oil separates and pools on top, 8 to 10 min
Stir in the tomato sauce, sugar and the rest of the salt
Add the santan and put the chicken back in. Simmer, stirring now and then
Gravy thick enough to coat the chicken, 10 min
Add the sliced onion and tomato wedges
Onion just soft but still holds its shape
ayam-masak-kicap: Heat the oil and fry the potato wedges
Golden at the edges, about 8 min. Set aside
Fry the chicken in the same oil
Lightly browned all over, 10 min. Set aside
Leave 2 tbsp oil. Fry the cinnamon and star anise, then the pounded garlic and ginger
Fragrant and light golden. Don't let the garlic burn
Add the kicap manis, dark soy, sugar, salt and 1 cup water
Put the chicken and potato back in. Simmer uncovered
Sauce glossy and thick enough to coat a spoon, 15 min
Add the onion rings, toss and turn off the heat
ayam-goreng-berempah: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger and lemongrass
Mix the paste with the turmeric, chili powder and salt, and rub it all over the chicken
Marinate at least 30 min. Overnight in the fridge is best
Heat the oil for deep frying on medium
A bit of paste dropped in sizzles straight away
Fry the chicken in batches, turning once
Deep golden and crisp, juices run clear, 12 to 15 min
Fry the curry leaves in the same oil and scatter over the chicken
kari-ayam: Mix the curry powder with a little water into a thick paste
Like wet sand, no dry lumps
Heat the oil. Fry the cinnamon, star anise and curry leaves
Add the sliced onion, garlic and ginger. Tumis
Onion soft and light golden, 3 min
Add the curry paste. Lower the heat and keep stirring
Pecah minyak: oil separates and the paste darkens, 6 to 8 min
Add the chicken and stir to coat, then the potato and 2 cups water. Cover
Stir in the santan and salt. Simmer gently
Smooth and slightly thick. Don't boil hard or the santan splits
ayam-masak-lemak-cili-api: Pound the chili padi, shallots, garlic and ginger with the turmeric
Bring the paste, bruised lemongrass and 1 cup water to the boil
Add the chicken and potato. Cover and cook
Chicken cooked through, potato nearly soft, 20 min
Pour in the santan and salt. Lower the heat and stir often
Gentle bubbles only, never a hard boil, or the santan splits (pecah santan)
ayam-kurma: Mix the kurma powder with a little water into a paste
Heat the oil. Fry the cinnamon and star anise
Add the sliced onion, garlic and ginger. Tumis
Add the kurma paste and stir on low heat
Add the chicken, potato and 1.5 cups water. Cover
Add the santan, tomato wedges and salt. Simmer gently
ayam-halia: Marinate the chicken with the light soy, sesame oil and cornflour
15 min, while you cut the ginger into strips
Heat the oil and fry the ginger strips
Golden at the edges and very fragrant, 2 to 3 min
Add the chicken on high heat and spread it out
Add the oyster sauce, dark soy, sugar and half a cup of water. Cover
Chicken cooked through and the sauce reduced, 10 min
Toss in the spring onion and turn off the heat
ayam-masam-manis: Dip the chicken cubes in beaten egg, then coat in the flour mixed with half the cornflour
Deep fry in hot oil in batches
Crisp and pale golden, 5 to 6 min. Drain
Leave 1 tbsp oil. Fry the onion and capsicum
Add the tomato, tomato sauce, chili sauce, sugar, salt and half a cup of water
Stir in the rest of the cornflour mixed with a little water
Toss the chicken in the sauce and serve straight away
Toss at the last minute so the coating stays crisp
ayam-kung-pao: Marinate the diced chicken with the light soy and cornflour
Toast the peanuts in a dry pan. Set aside
Heat the oil. Fry the cut dried chili, garlic and ginger
Chili darkens a shade. Not black
Add the chicken on high heat
Add the dark soy, oyster sauce, sugar and onion. Toss
Turn off the heat and toss in the peanuts
ayam-lada-hitam: Marinate the chicken with the cornflour and a spoon of the oyster sauce
Heat the oil. Fry the garlic and crushed black pepper
Add the chicken and spread it out
Cooked through and browned, 6 to 7 min
Add the rest of the oyster sauce, the kicap manis and a splash of water
Add the onion and capsicum and toss
sup-ayam: Heat the oil. Fry the pounded onion, garlic and ginger with the soup spice
Add the chicken, stir for a minute, then pour in 1.5 litres water
Comes to the boil. Skim off any foam
Add the potato and carrot. Simmer
Season with salt. Add the tomato and spring onion, then turn off the heat
tomyam-ayam: Boil 1.2 litres water with the bruised lemongrass and tom yam paste
Add the cabbage, onion, tomato and chili padi
Season with the fish sauce and sugar. Turn off the heat, then squeeze in the lime
Lime goes in off the heat so it stays fresh, not bitter
daging-masak-kicap: Boil the thinly sliced beef in 2 cups water
Tender when pressed with a spoon, about 40 min. Keep the stock
Heat the oil. Fry the garlic, ginger and half the onion
Add the beef with a cup of its stock, the kicap manis, dark soy, sugar and salt
Add the rest of the onion, the tomato and the sliced chili
rendang-daging: Blend the soaked dried chili, shallots, garlic, ginger, galangal and lemongrass
Heat the oil and tumis the paste with the turmeric on medium-low
Pecah minyak and a shade darker, 12 to 15 min
Add the beef and stir to coat
Add the santan and 1 cup water. Simmer uncovered, stirring every 10 minutes
Gravy reduced by half and beef tender, about 1.5 hours
Add the sugar and salt and keep stirring on low heat
Almost dry, dark brown, oil coming out again, 20 min
kari-daging: Mix the curry powder with a little water into a thick paste
Heat the oil. Fry the cinnamon, star anise and curry leaves
Add the sliced onion, garlic and ginger. Tumis
Add the curry paste. Stir on low heat
Add the beef and 3 cups water. Cover and simmer
Stir in the santan and salt. Simmer gently
sup-daging: Pound the onion, garlic and ginger
Boil the beef with the paste and soup spice in 1.5 litres water
Beef tender, 60 min. Top up the water if it drops
Season with salt, add the spring onion and turn off the heat
kari-kambing: Mix the curry powder with a little water into a thick paste
Heat the oil. Fry the fennel, cinnamon, star anise and curry leaves
Add the sliced onion, garlic and ginger. Tumis
Add the curry paste and tomato. Stir on low heat
Pecah minyak and the tomato broken down, 8 min
Add the mutton and 3 cups water. Cover and simmer
Potato soft and gravy thick, 20 min
ikan-goreng-kunyit: Clean the fish and score both sides
Rub with the turmeric and salt
Heat the oil and slide in the fish
Oil shimmers; a pinch of turmeric sizzles hard
Fry without moving the fish, then turn once
Crisp and golden on both sides, 3 to 4 min each side
asam-pedas: Blend the soaked dried chili, shallots, garlic, ginger and belacan
Heat the oil and tumis the paste with the lemongrass
Squeeze the tamarind in 3 cups water, strain, and pour it in
Add the fish, salt and sugar. Simmer gently without stirring
Fish opaque and flakes easily, 8 min
gulai-lemak-ikan: Pound the chili padi, shallots, garlic and ginger with the turmeric
Bring the paste, bruised lemongrass and 1 cup water to the boil
Add the santan and okra. Keep it at a gentle simmer
Small bubbles only, never a hard boil
Add the fish, a little tamarind water and the salt
kari-ikan: Mix the fish curry powder with a little water into a paste
Heat the oil. Fry the curry leaves, then the onion, garlic and ginger
Add the curry paste. Stir on low heat
Add 2 cups tamarind water, the brinjal and okra
Add the fish, tomato, santan and salt. Simmer gently
ikan-masak-kicap: Salt the fish and fry in hot oil
Crisp on both sides, about 8 min. Set aside
Leave 2 tbsp oil. Fry the garlic and ginger
Add the kicap manis and half a cup of water
Add the onion, chili and tomato
Pour the sauce over the fish
siakap-stim-limau: Clean and score the fish, rub with a little salt, and lay it on the bruised lemongrass on a steaming plate
Flesh white right to the bone, 12 to 15 min
Meanwhile mix the chopped garlic, chili padi, lime juice, fish sauce and sugar with 3 tbsp hot water
Taste it: sour, salty, sweet and spicy in balance
Pour off the steaming water, spoon the sauce over and top with spring onion
tilapia-masam-manis: Salt the fish and deep fry
Crisp all over, about 10 min. Drain
Leave 1 tbsp oil. Fry the onion
Add the tomato sauce, chili sauce, sugar and half a cup of water
Add the tomato and cucumber, then the cornflour mixed with a little water
Pour the sauce over the fish
sambal-udang: Blend the soaked dried chili, shallots, garlic and belacan
Heat the oil and tumis the paste on low heat
Pecah minyak and deep red, 10 to 12 min
Add the tamarind water, sugar and salt
Add the prawns and onion rings
Prawns pink and curled, 3 to 4 min
udang-masak-lemak: Pound the chili padi, shallots and garlic with the turmeric
Boil the paste with the bruised lemongrass and half a cup of water
Add the santan. Keep it at a gentle simmer
sotong-sambal: Blend the soaked dried chili, shallots and garlic
Heat the oil and tumis the paste on low heat
Add the tamarind water, sugar and salt
Add the squid rings and onion
Squid just opaque, 3 min. Longer makes it rubbery
sambal-ikan-bilis: Heat the oil and fry the ikan bilis
Crisp and golden, 3 min. Set aside
Fry the peanuts in the same oil
Blend the soaked dried chili, shallots and garlic
Leave 4 tbsp oil. Tumis the paste on low heat
Add the tamarind water, sugar, salt and onion rings
Toss in half the ikan bilis. Serve the rest and the peanuts on top
Add them last so they stay crunchy
telur-dadar: Beat the eggs with the onion, chili, spring onion and salt
Heat the oil until hot and pour in the eggs
Edges puffed, crisp and lacy, 2 min
Flip and cook the other side
sambal-telur: Boil the eggs, cool in water and peel
Fry the peeled eggs in the oil
Blistered and golden, 3 min. Set aside
Blend the soaked dried chili, shallots and garlic
Tumis the paste in the same oil on low heat
Add the tamarind water, sugar, salt and onion rings
Roll the eggs in the sambal
tauhu-goreng-kicap: Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in the oil
Golden and crisp on all sides, 6 min. Set aside
Leave 1 tbsp oil. Fry the garlic, onion and chili
Add the kicap manis, light soy and a splash of water
Toss the tofu in the sauce and top with spring onion
sambal-tempe-bilis: Cut the tempe into thin sticks and fry in the oil
Fry the ikan bilis, then the peanuts, in the same oil
Blend the soaked dried chili, shallots and garlic and tumis in 3 tbsp of the oil
Add the kicap manis, sugar and a little tamarind water
Turn off the heat and toss everything together
Off the heat so it stays crunchy
telur-kukus: Beat the eggs with salt and 1.5 times their volume of warm water, then strain
Cover and steam on low heat
Set but still wobbles like custard, 12 min
Drizzle the soy and sesame oil and top with spring onion
kari-dhal: Rinse the dhal and boil with the turmeric in 1 litre water
Add the potato, carrot and brinjal
In a small pan, heat the oil and fry the dried chili and curry leaves
Add the onion and garlic, then the curry powder
Pour this into the dhal with the tomato and salt
kangkung-belacan: Pound the chili, shallots, garlic, belacan and dried shrimp
Heat the oil on high and fry the paste
Add the leaves and sugar and toss
Just wilted (layu) and still bright green
sawi-bawang-putih: Heat the oil and fry the chopped garlic
Add the leaves, oyster sauce, salt and a splash of water
kubis-goreng: Heat the oil. Fry the garlic, onion and dried shrimp
Add the shredded cabbage and carrot
Cabbage softened but still crunchy, 3 min
Push to one side and scramble the egg in the gap
Season with salt and toss everything together
taugeh-ikan-masin: Heat the oil and fry the diced salted fish
Add the taugeh on high heat with the salt
Hot through but still crunchy, 45 sec
bayam-masak-air: Boil 3 cups water with the garlic, onion and dried shrimp
Pour the beaten egg in a thin stream while stirring, then season
kacang-panjang-telur: Heat the oil. Fry the garlic and onion
Add the cut long beans and a splash of water
Add the beaten eggs and scramble through, then season
bendi-belacan: Pound the chili, shallots, belacan and dried shrimp
Heat the oil and fry the paste
Add the sliced okra and stir-fry
terung-sambal: Cut the brinjal and fry in the oil
Blend the soaked dried chili, shallots, garlic and belacan. Tumis in 3 tbsp of the oil
Add a little tamarind water and the sugar
Spoon the sambal over the brinjal
kailan-sos-tiram: Blanch the kailan in boiling water and drain
Heat the oil and fry the garlic
Add the oyster sauce, sugar and a splash of water, then pour over the kailan
pakchoy-sos-tiram: Blanch the halved pak choy and drain
Heat the oil and fry the garlic
Add the oyster sauce, sesame oil and a splash of water, then pour over
sayur-campur: Heat the oil and fry the garlic
Add the carrot and cauliflower with a splash of water
Season with the oyster sauce and salt, then stir in the cornflour mixed with a little water
kubis-masak-lemak: Pound the shallots, chili padi, turmeric and dried shrimp
Boil the paste with 1 cup water
Add the santan and salt. Simmer gently
sayur-lodeh: Cube the tofu and fry in a little oil
Pound the shallots, garlic, turmeric and dried shrimp and fry in the same pan
Add 1 cup water, the carrot and long beans
Add the santan, tofu and salt. Simmer gently
brokoli-bawang-putih: Heat the oil and fry plenty of garlic
Add the broccoli and salt, then a splash of cornflour mixed with water
buncis-telur: Heat the oil. Fry the garlic and onion
Add the sliced beans and a splash of water
Add the beaten eggs and scramble through, then season
kubis-cina-udang-kering: Soak the dried shrimp 10 min and chop
Heat the oil and fry the garlic and dried shrimp
Add the cabbage and a splash of water
nasi-goreng-kampung: Cook the rice ahead and let it cool
Heat the oil and fry the ikan bilis
Fry the eggs sunny side up in the same oil
Pound the shallots, garlic, chili padi and belacan and fry in the oil left in the pan
Add the rice on high heat and toss
Add the kangkung, light soy and salt
Serve topped with the eggs and ikan bilis
nasi-goreng-ayam: Cook the rice ahead and let it cool
Heat the oil. Fry the garlic and onion
Push aside and scramble the eggs
Add the rice, chili sauce, kicap manis and light soy on high heat
mee-goreng-mamak: Cube and fry the tofu in the oil
Fry the garlic and onion with the chili powder
Add the noodles with the tomato sauce, chili sauce, kicap manis and light soy
Add the potato, tofu and cabbage
Add the taugeh, toss and serve with lime
bihun-goreng: Soak the bihun in water and drain
Heat the oil. Fry the shallots, garlic and chili powder
Add the egg and scramble, then the carrot and cabbage
Add the bihun with the light soy, kicap manis, oyster sauce and half a cup of water. Toss
kuetiau-goreng: Loosen the kuetiau strands with your hands
Heat the oil on high. Fry the garlic
Add the kuetiau with the dark soy, light soy, oyster sauce and chili sauce
Push aside, fry the eggs in the gap, then mix in
Add the taugeh and spring onion and toss
mee-sup-ayam: Pound the onion, garlic and ginger
Boil the chicken with the paste and soup spice in 2 litres water
Shred the chicken and season the broth with salt and light soy
Blanch the noodles, sawi and taugeh
Assemble the bowls and top with chicken and spring onion. Serve chili padi in soy on the side
nasi-lemak: Rinse the rice and cook it with the santan, water, lemongrass, ginger and half the salt
Heat the oil and fry the ikan bilis, then the peanuts
Both golden, about 7 min. Set aside
Blend the soaked dried chili, shallots and garlic
Tumis the paste in 4 tbsp of the oil on low heat
Add the tamarind water, sugar, the rest of the salt and the onion rings
Serve the rice with sambal, eggs, ikan bilis, peanuts and sliced cucumber
bubur-ayam: Boil the rice with the ginger in 2 litres water, stirring often
Porridge creamy and chicken tender, 40 min. Shred the chicken
Fry the sliced shallots and garlic in the oil
Season with salt, white pepper and light soy
Serve topped with spring onion and the crispy shallots
nasi-ayam: Poach the chicken with half the ginger in water
Juices run clear, 35 min. Keep the broth
Heat the oil. Fry the garlic, shallots and the rest of the ginger
Add the rinsed rice and stir to coat, then cook it in the broth with salt
Blend the chili with a little garlic, ginger, lime juice, broth and sugar
Slice the chicken and dress with the dark soy, light soy and sesame oil
Serve with sliced cucumber and tomato
ayam-percik: Soak the dried chili in hot water, then blend with the shallots, garlic, ginger and lemongrass
Rub the chicken with the turmeric and a little of the salt
Heat the oil and tumis the paste on low-medium heat
Pecah minyak: the oil separates, 6 to 8 min
Add the santan, tamarind water, sugar and the rest of the salt. Simmer, stirring, until thick
Thick enough to coat a spoon
Grill or pan-sear the chicken, basting with the gravy and turning often
Charred at the edges and cooked through, about 20 min
Pour the rest of the gravy over to serve
ayam-goreng-kunyit: Pound the garlic to a paste
Rub the chicken with the turmeric, chili powder, salt and garlic. Leave 15 min
Heat the oil in a wok on medium
A drop of marinade sizzles at once
Fry the chicken in batches, turning once
Deep golden and crisp, about 12 min
ayam-sos-tiram: Toss the chicken with the cornflour and a spoon of the oyster sauce. Leave 10 min
Heat the oil and fry the chicken until browned
Add the garlic, ginger and onion and stir-fry
Add the rest of the oyster sauce, the dark soy, sugar, salt and half a cup of water. Simmer
Glossy, thick sauce and the chicken cooked through
Toss in the spring onion and serve
ayam-goreng-madu: Season the wings with the salt and pepper and coat lightly in flour
Pour off the oil and fry the chopped garlic
Add the honey, light soy and oyster sauce and let it bubble
Toss the wings in the glaze and scatter the sesame seeds
daging-lada-hitam: Slice the beef thinly against the grain and toss with the cornflour
Heat the oil until smoking and sear the beef in 2 batches. Lift out
Fry the garlic and crushed black pepper
Add the onion and capsicum and stir-fry
Put the beef back with the oyster sauce, dark soy, sugar, salt and a third of a cup of water. Toss
daging-masak-merah: Boil the beef pieces in 3 cups of water until tender. Keep the stock
A fork slides in easily, about 40 min
Blend the soaked dried chili with the shallots, garlic and ginger
Heat the oil and fry the cinnamon and star anise
Pecah minyak: the oil separates, 8 to 10 min
Add the beef, a cup of the stock, the tomato sauce, sugar and salt. Simmer
Add the sliced onion and tomato wedges and cook 2 min
ikan-bakar-air-asam: Clean and score the fish, then rub with the turmeric and salt
Toast the belacan in a dry pan
Pound the chili padi with the belacan, then mix with the tamarind water, sliced shallot, chopped tomato, sugar and lime juice
Sour, spicy and a little sweet
Brush the fish with oil and grill, turning once
The skin blisters and the flesh flakes at the bone, about 15 min
ikan-goreng-sambal: Rub the fish with the turmeric
Fry the fish in hot oil, turning once. Set aside
Blend the soaked chili with the shallots, garlic and belacan
Pour off all but 4 tbsp oil and tumis the paste
Add the tamarind water, sugar, salt and the sliced onion
The sambal is thick and shiny
Spoon the sambal over the fish
ikan-tiga-rasa: Score the fish, rub with salt and dust with flour
Crisp skin, white at the bone
Pour off most of the oil and fry the garlic, chili and chili padi
Add the tomato sauce, chili sauce, tamarind water, sugar, fish sauce and half a cup of water. Simmer
ikan-selar-sumbat: Clean the fish and slit along both sides of the backbone to make a pocket
Blend the soaked chili with the shallots, garlic and belacan
Tumis the paste in 3 tbsp of the oil with the sugar
Rub the fish with the turmeric and salt, then fill the pockets with sambal
Shallow-fry the fish in the rest of the oil, turning carefully
Crisp and golden on both sides
udang-masak-kicap: Peel and devein the prawns, leaving the tails on
Heat the oil and fry the garlic and shallots
Add the kicap manis, light soy, sugar, salt and 3 tbsp water
Toss in the sliced chili and onion
The onion still has a little crunch
sotong-goreng-tepung: Clean the squid, cut into rings and pat dry
Mix the flour, cornflour, chili powder, pepper and salt
Dip the rings in beaten egg, then coat in the flour mix
Fully coated; shake off the excess
Deep-fry in batches in hot oil
Light golden and crisp, about 2 min a batch. Longer makes it rubbery
sambal-kerang: Scrub the cockles, blanch 1 min, then take them out of the shells
Blend the soaked chili with the shallots, garlic and belacan
Heat the oil and tumis the paste
Add the tamarind water, sugar, salt and sliced onion
Stir in the cockles and turn off the heat
Just heated; longer makes them tough
telur-masak-kicap: Boil the eggs 9 min, cool and peel
Shallow-fry the eggs in the oil, rolling them around
Pour off most of the oil and fry the garlic and onion
Add the kicap manis, dark soy, sugar, salt and half a cup of water
Add the eggs and sliced chili and coat well
kari-telur: Boil the eggs 9 min, cool and peel
Mix the curry powder with a little water
Heat the oil and fry the cinnamon, star anise and curry leaves
Add the onion, garlic and ginger and tumis
Add the curry paste and fry
Add the potato cubes and a cup and a half of water. Simmer
Add the santan, tomato, salt and eggs. Simmer gently
The gravy thickens; don't let the santan boil hard
buncis-goreng-udang: Fry the garlic in the oil
Add the beans, oyster sauce, salt and 3 tbsp water. Stir-fry
kobis-bunga-goreng: Cut the cauliflower into florets and slice the carrot
Fry the garlic in the oil
Add the vegetables and a quarter cup of water. Cover
Add the oyster sauce and salt, then the cornflour mixed with a little water
acar-timun: Cut the cucumber and carrot into sticks; slice the onion and chili
Toss with the salt, leave 10 min, then squeeze dry
Fry the garlic and turmeric in the oil
Add the vinegar and sugar, bring to the boil, then cool
Pour over the vegetables, mix, and top with crushed peanuts
mee-kari: Boil the eggs 9 min and peel; blanch the taugeh and noodles
Blend the shallots, garlic and lemongrass
Tumis the paste with the curry powder in the oil
Add the chicken and 4 cups of water. Simmer
Add the santan, cubed tofu, sugar and salt. Simmer gently
Pour over the noodles and top with egg, chili padi and lime
nasi-tomato: Rub the chicken with the turmeric, chili powder and half the salt
Fry the onion, garlic, ginger, cinnamon and star anise in the oil
Add the chopped tomato and tomato sauce and cook down
Stir in the rice, milk, the rest of the salt and a cup and a half of water. Cook in the rice cooker or a covered pot
The water is absorbed and the grains are tender
Meanwhile bake or pan-grill the chicken
Golden and the juices run clear
bihun-sup: Boil the chicken in 6 cups of water with the ginger and soup spice
Cooked through. Shred it and keep the stock
Fry the sliced shallots and garlic in the oil
Soak the bihun in hot water and drain
Season the stock with the salt and pepper, then blanch the sawi and taugeh in it
Put noodles, greens and chicken in bowls, ladle the soup over, and top with fried shallots and spring onion
mee-hailam: Slice the chicken and carrot; blanch the noodles
Fry the garlic in the oil
Add the chicken and prawns and stir-fry
The prawns are pink and the chicken white
Add 2 cups of water, the sauces, pepper, salt, carrot and sawi. Boil
Add the noodles, thicken with the cornflour mixed in water, then swirl in the beaten egg
A thick gravy with egg ribbons
tom-kha-gai: Bruise the lemongrass and slice the galangal
Bring the santan and 2 cups of water to a gentle simmer with the lemongrass and galangal
Add the sliced chicken and mushrooms
Add the tomato, fish sauce, sugar, salt and bruised chili padi
Turn off the heat and squeeze in the lime
pad-thai: Mix the tamarind water, fish sauce and sugar into a sauce
Fry the garlic, shallots and diced tofu in the oil
Push to one side and scramble the eggs
Add the noodles and the sauce and toss
The noodles are soft and the sauce absorbed
Toss in the taugeh and spring onion. Serve with crushed peanuts, chili powder and lime
khao-pad-gai: Use rice cooked a day ahead, or spread fresh rice out to cool
Fry the garlic and onion in the oil
Push aside and scramble the eggs
Add the rice, tomato, fish sauce, light soy and sugar. Toss over high heat
Serve with spring onion, cucumber, lime and chili padi
pla-rad-prik: Score the fish, salt it and dust with cornflour
Pound the garlic, chilies and shallots
Fry the paste in 2 tbsp of the oil
Add the tamarind water, fish sauce, sugar and a quarter cup of water. Simmer
kai-jeow: Beat the eggs with the fish sauce and 1 tbsp of water
Heat the oil in a wok until smoking
Pour in the eggs from a height
Puffs up and crisps at the edges
Flip and cook the other side
Top with spring onion and serve with chili sauce
mapo-tofu: Mince the beef finely and cube the tofu
Fry the garlic, ginger and chili powder in the oil
Add the chili sauce, soy sauces, sugar, pepper and a cup of water, then the tofu. Simmer
Thicken with the cornflour mixed in water; add the sesame oil and spring onion
telur-tomato: Beat the eggs with a pinch of the salt
Softly scramble the eggs in half the oil and lift out
Fry the tomato wedges in the rest of the oil
Add the ketchup, sugar, salt and a quarter cup of water, then thicken with the cornflour
Fold the eggs back in gently and top with spring onion
daging-brokoli: Slice the beef thinly and toss with half the cornflour
Sear the beef in hot oil and lift out
Add the oyster sauce, dark soy, sugar, salt and half a cup of water; put the beef and broccoli back and thicken with the rest of the cornflour
ayam-stim-cendawan: Cut the chicken into pieces and slice the mushrooms and ginger
Mix with the oyster sauce, light soy, sesame oil, cornflour, sugar and pepper. Leave 15 min
Spread on a plate and steam over high heat
The chicken is cooked through and the juices clear, about 20 min
ayam-teriyaki: Mix the soy, sugar, honey, grated ginger, garlic and 4 tbsp of water
Pan-fry the chicken skin-side down in the oil
The skin is crisp and golden
Flip and cook the other side
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble, turning the chicken. Thicken with the cornflour if needed
Slice and top with sesame seeds and spring onion
oyakodon: Dissolve the stock cube in a cup of hot water with the soy and sugar
Simmer the sliced onion in the stock
Add the chicken pieces and simmer
Pour in the lightly beaten eggs and cover
Just set, still soft on top
Slide over bowls of rice and top with spring onion
chicken-katsu: Butterfly the chicken, pound to an even thickness and season
Coat in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs
Fry in hot oil, turning once
Deep golden and cooked through, about 8 min
Mix the ketchup, oyster sauce and sugar for the sauce
Slice and serve with finely shredded cabbage
ayam-gochujang: Mix the gochujang, soy, sugar, honey, garlic and ginger
Coat the chicken pieces in half the sauce and leave 15 min
Fry the chicken in the oil
Add the onion, cabbage, the rest of the sauce and a quarter cup of water
The chicken is cooked, the cabbage soft and the sauce sticky
Finish with sesame oil, sesame seeds and spring onion
japchae: Soak the sohun, boil 5 min and drain
Blanch the bayam and squeeze dry
Fry the beaten egg into a thin omelette and slice it
Stir-fry the beef strips with the garlic in the oil
Add the carrot, onion and mushroom
Toss everything with the soy, sugar, sesame oil, pepper and seeds
bibimbap: Toss the beef strips with the soy, sugar and garlic
Blanch the bayam and taugeh separately and season with sesame oil
Stir-fry the carrot sticks, then the beef, in the oil
The whites are set, the yolks runny
Top the rice with everything, a spoon of gochujang and sesame seeds. Mix before eating
spaghetti-aglio-olio: Boil the spaghetti in salted water 1 min less than the packet says. Keep a cup of the pasta water
Al dente: a little bite left
Gently fry the sliced garlic and chili flakes in the oil
Toss in the pasta with a splash of the pasta water
A silky sauce coats the pasta
Finish with pepper, lemon, spring onion and grated cheese
spaghetti-bolognese: Finely chop the onion, carrot and garlic
Add the chopped tomato, ketchup, herbs, sugar, salt, pepper and a cup of water. Simmer
Serve the sauce on the pasta with grated cheese
pasta-ayam-cendawan: Season the chicken strips and fry in the butter. Lift out
Fry the onion, garlic and mushrooms
Stir in the flour, then slowly the milk
Add the cheese, herbs, salt, pepper, the chicken and pasta. Toss
chicken-chop: Season the thighs with salt and half the pepper and dust with flour
Cut the potatoes into wedges and fry until golden
Pan-fry the chicken skin-side down, then turn
Melt the butter and fry the onion, garlic and the rest of the pepper
Add the oyster sauce, dark soy, sugar, milk and a quarter cup of water. Simmer
Toss the shredded cabbage and carrot with the vinegar for the coleslaw, and serve everything together
fish-and-chips: Cut the potatoes into thick chips, soak 10 min and pat dry
Fry the chips until soft but pale. Lift out
Whisk the flour, cornflour, egg, salt, pepper and cold water into a batter
Dip the fish pieces in batter and fry
Serve with lemon and a quick slaw of cabbage, vinegar and sugar
shepherds-pie: Fry the onion, carrot and garlic in the oil
Stir in the flour, then the ketchup, soy, stock cube, herbs and a cup of water. Simmer
Mash the potatoes with the butter, milk, salt and pepper
Spread the mash over the beef, top with cheese and bake at 200°C
Golden and bubbling at the edges
ikan-lemon-mentega: Season the fish, dust with flour and pan-fry in the oil
Melt the butter with the garlic, then squeeze in the lemon
Mash the potatoes with the milk and some of the lemon butter; spoon the rest over the fish
stew-ayam: Season the chicken and brown it in the butter
Add the potato, carrot, stock cube, herbs, soy and 3 cups of water. Simmer covered
The vegetables are tender and the chicken falls off the bone
Stir in the milk, salt and pepper
udang-butter-bawang-putih: Peel the prawns, leaving the tails on, pat dry and season
Melt the butter and fry the garlic and chili
Squeeze in the lemon and top with spring onion
coleslaw: Finely shred the cabbage, carrot and onion
Whisk the milk, vinegar, sugar, lemon juice, salt and pepper
